# Real materials update
- nokia-n73-real.jpg — Paul3vanz, 2007-01-17, public domain. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Nokia-N73.jpg . Cropped and UV mapped to N73 front.
- nokia-5230-front.jpg — Anton Bagrin, 2009-08-25, CC BY-SA 3.0. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Nokia-5230-black1.jpg . Cropped and UV mapped to front; textured 5230 model and .blend derivative distributed under CC BY-SA 3.0. https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/
- charger-2008.jpg — Mark Guim, 2008-09-11, CC BY 2.0. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Solar_charger_4.jpg . Mapped to catalogue card. https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/
- battery-bl4c.jpg — Myles Findlay, 2009-12-14, CC BY-SA 3.0. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:BL-4C_Nokia_battery.jpg . Cropped battery label and catalogue card. Textured shop model and .blend derivative distributed under CC BY-SA 3.0. https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/
- phone-shop-2007.jpg — Paul Scott, Accra, 2007-04-24, CC BY-SA 2.0. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mobile_phone_shop_Accra_2007_B002.jpg . Unmodified reference folder photograph, not the fictional Chinese shop. https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/
- seg-2010.jpg — Bobbie Johnson, Shenzhen SEG Plaza, 2010-08-04, CC BY-SA 2.0. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Inside_SEG_Plaza_(Bobbie_Johnson)_-_Flickr.jpg . Unmodified reference folder photograph. https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/

# N73 and shop refinement / 2026-10-20
- n73-camera-2007.jpg — Komatta, June 2007, public domain. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Nokia_N73_Carl_Zeiss_Tessar_Lens.jpg . Unmodified reference folder photo; factual lens/flash arrangement informs independently rebuilt geometry.
- n73-rear-open-2007.jpg — Alx 91, 2007, CC BY-SA 2.5. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:NokiaN73Cameraopen.jpg . Unmodified reference folder photo; open slider and logo orientation reference. https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.5/
- battery-bl5c-2007.jpg — Adam Brookes (Adambro), 2007-08-15, CC BY-SA 3.0. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:BL-5C_Nokia_battery.jpg . Resized and mapped to independent spare battery; original shown in inspection. Textured shop derivative distributed under CC BY-SA 3.0. https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/
- ../materials/plaster-diff.jpg — Amal Kumar, Painted Plaster Wall, Poly Haven, CC0. https://polyhaven.com/a/painted_plaster_wall . Modern photographed surface texture used to evoke wear; NOT an archive photograph of a 2008 shop. https://polyhaven.com/license
- ../materials/wood-diff.jpg — Dimitrios Savva (photography), Rico Cilliers (processing), Wood Table 001, Poly Haven, CC0. https://polyhaven.com/a/wood_table_001 . Modern photographed surface texture, not historical shop evidence. https://polyhaven.com/license
